Attached: 1 image

Before you blame your willpower, wait ten minutes.

When the urge hits, set a ten-minute timer, write the urge down in five words ("I want to check email"), and do one small task while you wait, like filling a glass of water. When the timer rings, decide again. Either answer is allowed.

The pause is the skill you're training, not the mood.

#habits #productivity
